summary: Completed regression testing of the public NyayaAI API and Q&A, citations, copy controls, source library, dashboard, and mobile layout.
action_items: Keep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported/configured when running the pytest regression suite; without it the three tests skip rather than execute.
critical_code_review_comments: The local deterministic SLM and seeded in-memory SOURCES/HISTORY remain intentionally MOCKED; research history is not persistent across backend restarts.
rank_sources falls back to SOURCES[:3] when a scoped query has no matches, which can return citations outside the selected category; consider returning an explicit no-match response instead.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 configured pytest tests; direct endpoint probes also passed)

seed_data_creation: None; used the existing seeded legal corpus and session history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health, analytics, statutes search/detail/404, scoped query validation, Q&A answer metrics/disclaimer/citations, citation modal, answer/source copy controls, BNSS filter, library search, dashboard, and 390px overflow all passed. No auth flow applies. MOCKED local SLM and in-memory corpus/history are intentional.
rca of the issue: No unresolved runtime issue found in this iteration. The initial clipboard rejection and stale library category bugs from iteration 1 were retested successfully after the implementation changes.
